parameters.query:
SELECT 
    conv.*,
    c_workflow.concept_name      AS "workflowType",
    i.instrument_id              AS "instrumentId",
    i.instrument_source_value    AS "instrumentSourceValue",
    c_instrument.concept_name    AS "instrumentModel",
    c_reads.concept_name         AS "readsSettings"
FROM conversions conv
INNER JOIN runs r               ON conv.run_ref = r.uniqueref
INNER JOIN concepts c_workflow  ON r.workflow_concept_ref = c_workflow.uniqueref
INNER JOIN instruments i        ON r.instrument_ref = i.uniqueref
INNER JOIN concepts c_instrument ON i.instrument_concept_ref = c_instrument.uniqueref
LEFT JOIN concepts c_reads      ON r.reads_settings_concept_ref = c_reads.uniqueref
WHERE conv.uniqueref = {{ $json.conversion_ref }}

SELECT input1.*,
       agg.index_ref,
       agg.index_match_count
FROM input1
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT MIN(input2.index_ref)::int AS index_ref,
         COUNT(*)::int            AS index_match_count
  FROM input2
  WHERE input2.i7_sequence = input1."Index"
    AND input2.i5_sequence = input1."Index2"
) agg ON TRUE

SELECT 
    input2.*,
    prepared_map.care_site_ref AS performing_care_site_ref,
    requested_map.care_site_ref AS requesting_caresite_ref
FROM input2
LEFT JOIN input1 AS prepared_map
    ON input2.Prepared_By = prepared_map.care_site_source_value
LEFT JOIN input1 AS requested_map
    ON input2.Requested_By = requested_map.care_site_source_value
